rows.text: receives in-principle approval from both exchanges to issue equity shares on a preferential basis as consideration for acquiring NEO Semi SG Pte Ltd, Singapore (new; a stage below allotment).
Brickwork lifts its bank facilities **from BWR BB/Stable to BWR BBB-/Stable**, and the guarantee line from A4+ to A3, on **Rs 110.82 crore** rated.
